title: @intentsolutions/core authoring schema index v2 (STRICT profile)
description: Catalog of the STRICT v2 authoring-contract schemas. v2 is a fresh, self-contained sibling of authoring/v1 with ZERO $ref into v1 (copy-then-tighten / copy-then-regenerate); v1 is BYTE-FROZEN at @intentsolutions/core@0.4.1. skill-frontmatter was forked first (DR-049 — closes the 4 CCP-shadow frontmatter gaps; its v2 base is a byte-copy of the v1 base modulo $id). Per DR-062 the five remaining contracts (mcp-config, plugin-manifest, agent-definition, hook-config, marketplace-catalog) gain v2 siblings whose bases are REGENERATED from the captured projections at intent-eval-lab specs/_vendor/upstream/<contract>/projection.json (documented fields only, upstream requiredness, upstream wire forms); every IS narrowing/extension relocates to the is-overlay with a convergence trigger. The v2 marketplace-tier foundation carries the THREE universal folds with two security tightenings (shell-substitution-widen + reserved-name-substring-hardening) + one disclosure tightening (description cap 1024). skill-frontmatter v2 additionally narrows allowed-tools (scoped-Bash). Sources of truth: DR-049 + the CCP kernel-shadow finding; DR-062 (tier-3 reconciliation) for the five projection-mirrored contracts.
